Comcast to Separate Cable Business from Media Operations

Comcast announced plans to split its operations into two distinct publicly traded companies. One entity will focus on broadband and cable services, while the other will house its media assets, including NBCUniversal and Sky. This strategic move aims to streamline operations and potentially unlock greater value for shareholders.
